passive.name: Blast Shield
passive.text: Vi charges a shield over time. The shield can be activated by hitting an enemy with an ability.

spells.name: Vault Breaker
spells.text: Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.

spells.name: Denting Blows
spells.text: Vi's punches break her opponent's Armor, dealing bonus damage and granting her Attack Speed.

spells.name: Relentless Force
spells.text: Vi's next attack blasts through her target, dealing damage to enemies behind it.

spells.name: Cease and Desist
spells.text: Vi runs down an enemy, knocking aside anyone in the way. When she reaches her target she knocks it into the air, jumps after it, and slams it back into the ground.

archetype.value: Vi is a jungle diver who uses mobility and engage to make plays.

winCondition.value: Vi wins by ambushing, securing objectives, and making impactful teamfight plays.

spikes.why: Vi can use Vault Breaker more often when its cooldown drops from 12 to 6 seconds.
Vi can use Cease and Desist more often when its cooldown drops from 140 to 90 seconds.

bait.why: Vi cannot use Cease and Desist’s targeted knock-up while it is on cooldown.
